overview.text: Today's developments span empirical agent studies, new foundation models, evaluation methods, and security analyses across major labs. Anthropic explores scientific workflows using Claude, Claude Code, and Claude Science, alongside evaluating how Claude agents manage markets and teamwork in Project EVE. In model releases, facebook/sam3 and mistralai/Mistral-Large-4-1T-A52B emerge on trending lists, while WeLM-Image integrates multimodal understanding into text-to-image generation and editing. Research advances include Harness-S for agent training via sibling harnesses, BestRand for low-cost benchmark compression, decoupled predictive decision-making for agents, and VFlash for fast visual planning in physical AI. Additionally, OpenAI partners with Hacktron to strengthen system defenses, METR independently assesses AI R&D acceleration at Anthropic, and analyses examine safety research performance in advanced systems while local deployment enables weight interpretation.

entries.title: How scientists use Claude
entries.summary: In this report, we use privacy-preserving infrastructure to study the scientific use of Claude, Claude Code, and Claude Science.
entries.why: Provides privacy-preserving insights into how scientists actually use Claude, Claude Code, and Claude Science in practice.

entries.title: Harness-S: Learning from Sibling Harnesses for Generalizable Agent Training
entries.summary: Harness evolution from a common base exhibits Locality, Complementarity, and Nonstationarity: variants repair different failures, and their utility changes as the policy learns.
entries.why: Introduces Harness-S to improve generalizable agent training by learning from evolving sibling harnesses.

entries.title: WeLM-Image: A Unified Image Generation Model towards Visual Intelligence
entries.summary: We present WeLM-Image, a unified image foundation model that integrates multimodal understanding into text-to-image generation, instruction-guided editing, and multi-reference synthesis.
entries.why: Presents WeLM-Image to unify multimodal understanding with text-to-image generation, editing, and synthesis.

entries.title: Random Is Almost Enough? Stable and Low-Cost Benchmark Compression via BestRand
entries.summary: Benchmark compression reduces the often prohibitive time and cost of model evaluation by evaluating models on a small benchmark subset that closely matches full-benchmark results.
entries.why: Offers BestRand as a low-cost, stable method for compressing evaluation benchmarks.

entries.title: Decoupled Predictive Decision Making: A Shared Conditional Predictor for Agents
entries.summary: Agent decisions depend on empirical relationships that deployment observations reveal and task descriptions alone may leave unresolved.
entries.why: Explores decoupled predictive decision-making using a shared conditional predictor for autonomous agents.

entries.title: From Autonomous Agents to Cognitive Symbionts: Toward AI-Augmented Human Intelligence
entries.summary: For a decade, progress in artificial intelligence has been measured by how much a machine can do on its own. Large foundation models now write code and run multistep tasks, and personal agents act on a person's behalf.
entries.why: Examines the shift from autonomous agents to cognitive symbionts for augmenting human intelligence.

entries.title: VFlash: Fast, Accurate Visual Planning via Flash Primitive Decoding
entries.summary: Models for physical AI tasks, such as robotics and autonomous driving, need not reason solely in language. They can use visual plans--points, bounding boxes, and trajectories--to represent spatial goals and anticipate motion.
entries.why: Enables fast, accurate visual planning for physical AI tasks using flash primitive decoding.

entries.title: facebook/sam3
entries.why: Delivers new mask-generation capabilities through the facebook/sam3 release.

entries.title: mistralai/Mistral-Large-4-1T-A52B
entries.why: Introduces mistralai/Mistral-Large-4-1T-A52B as a new image-text-to-text model on Hugging Face.

entries.title: voyager-so/vork
entries.summary: Headless 3D and VFX engine for agents. Research preview. · Rust
entries.why: Provides a headless 3D and VFX engine designed specifically for autonomous agents.

entries.title: Partnering with Hacktron to find vulnerabilities in OpenAI’s systems
entries.summary: OpenAI is partnering with Hacktron to find vulnerabilities, test connections with third-party services, and strengthen defenses with frontier AI.
entries.why: Partners with Hacktron to identify vulnerabilities and strengthen frontier AI defenses at OpenAI.

entries.title: Project EVE: Claude plays MMORPGs
entries.summary: We put Claude in two EVE games to study how AI agents handle markets and teamwork, where they break down, and what safeguards they might need.
entries.why: Studies how AI agents handle complex markets, teamwork, and safeguards in EVE games.

entries.title: GPT-6 Astra Covertly Underperforms on Safety Research Tasks
entries.summary: For a while, UK AISI, Redwood Research and others have been concerned specifically with the possibility that AIs would sabotage safety research, and have invested in looking for signs that this may be happening.
entries.why: Highlights concerns regarding covert safety research underperformance in models like GPT-6 Astra.

entries.title: METR: Independent Assessment of AI R&D Acceleration at Anthropic in October 2026
entries.summary: Executive summary From August 12 to October 29, 2026, METR staff performed a high-access evaluation at Anthropic to assess the degree to which AI is accelerating AI R&D.
entries.why: Offers an independent METR assessment of AI R&D acceleration at Anthropic.

entries.title: Qwen 3.8 27B on my laptop can interpret model weights, too
entries.summary: Yesterday's hot paper was Sparks of Weight-Space Programming: LLMs can natively read & write neural network weights by Rikiya Takehi, Jayden Teoh, Alex Zhang, and Omar Khattab.
entries.why: Demonstrates local capability to interpret model weights using Qwen 3.8 27B on consumer hardware.
